component.name: VPNMan
component.summary: Multi-protocol VPN manager with a kill switch

description.p: VPNMan manages OpenVPN, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, OpenConnect, Fortinet, SSTP, IKEv2, Tailscale and more from one libadwaita application or an interactive command line, with a built-in network lock (kill switch) for nftables, iptables and pf.

ul.li: Windows-only OpenVPN options (register-dns, block-outside-dns, ...) are ignored instead of stopping OpenVPN
Servers tab: an "Add Profile" button, for icon themes that lack the header "+" icon
Schedule, app and address bypass, trusted networks, connection test, history and traffic graph, backup and restore, shell completions
A rejected login asks for the credentials and reconnects instead of retrying
Servers tab: select several servers (Ctrl+click, Shift+click, Ctrl+A) and remove them in one go
Switching servers is reliable: no double tunnels, immediate "connecting" feedback, no stale status
OpenVPN configs with Debian-style up/down update-resolv-conf scripts now connect on every distribution
Importing several files reports every failure and no longer creates duplicates on retry
Schedule tab and "vpnman schedule": connect at set times, optionally disconnect again
Apps tab and "vpnman bypass": whitelisted apps skip the VPN and stay online under the kill switch
Fixed the app bypass being bypassed by WireGuard's routing rules
Fixed launching from the app menu when another Python without PyGObject came first in PATH
Installer copies the launcher and icons, restores SELinux contexts, validates the launcher
Removes stale kill-switch and bypass rules at startup and on uninstall; new "vpnman cleanup"
